title: Penalty for playing the wrong ball
question: While playing a hole, you hit a shot and then realise you played a ball that isn't yours. What should you do next according to the rules?

choices.text: Keep playing with the wrong ball for the rest of the hole
Stop, find your own ball, play it from where it was, add two penalty strokes, and ignore any strokes made with the wrong ball
Go back to the last tee and replay your shot
Put the wrong ball back where you found it and continue with that ball

explanation: You must stop and play your own ball from where it lay, adding two penalty strokes. Any strokes made with the wrong ball do not count.
